sloka: तम् हि नित्यम् महा राजो बलवन्तम् महा बलः ।उअपाश्रितः अभूद् धर्म आत्मा मेरुर् मेरु वनम् यथा ॥२-७३-१५॥
transliteration: tam hi nityam mahā rājo balavantam mahā balaḥ ।uapāśritaḥ abhūd dharma ātmā merur meru vanam yathā ॥2-73-15॥

translations.english: The mighty and righteous maharaja used to rely upon the powerful Rama just as mount Meru depends on the forest surrounding it for its protection.
